title: Image assets lack responsive delivery
summary: Framework pages serve large images without responsive sizes, modern formats, or lazy loading.
rationale: Image overdelivery is one of the largest avoidable frontend sustainability costs.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Use responsive image components, modern formats, lazy loading, and explicit dimensions.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
